experiments.decision_rule: Use the stronger hook family for a fast-follow derivative only if the comparison is interpretable; do not infer causality from unequal distribution alone.
Prefer the framing with stronger save/share behavior without loss of comprehension.
Do not amplify emotionally stronger framing if it distorts the scope-creep caveat.
Favor authority and accuracy over sensational AI-fear framing.
Reject any variant that implies QR codes are inherently unsafe.
Use formula-first only if mobile comprehension remains strong.
No deterministic manipulation claim is allowed in either variant.

strategy_change_rule: Operational winners may be amplified quickly; core positioning changes require repeated evidence across multiple independent observations.
